description.value: Portobello is an elevated casual dining cafe situated inside the Fairmont Chateau Whistler in Whistler's Upper Village, a locals' favourite known for its animated open kitchen. The restaurant features the only kitchen of its kind in Whistler — a Rotisol rotisserie, Alto-Shaam smoker, and antique European Miwe Wenz 1919 ovens — producing rotisserie chicken, smoked brisket, pork ribs, gourmet sandwiches, and fresh pastries. A full-service bar with local craft beers, a market-style retail space, and a summer outdoor patio with Adirondack chairs and a fire pit complete the rustic alpine setting.
